race.comment: VIVA VIVA (12) is yet to break through after 10 starts but not far off a win. Placed two back then missed the frame but was thereabouts last time over 1600m at Kembla Grange. The blinkers go on and gets her chance to break through. FIERCE CRITIC (11) drifted back when fresh from a spell last start and finished seventh over 1200m at this track. Placed at her only other second up appearance. Leading contender on her best form. ETERNAL TORMENT (6) Fastnet Rock gelding from a Savabeel mare on debut for the Maher stable. His two latest trials had merit and kicks off in a winnable race. GIANLUCA (7) was doing his best work late last start to get up for third over 1200m at this track. Best form puts him right in this. ADAPTATION (1) finds his weakest test to date and keep safe with the 59kg.
